Roth.exists_mem_RSet_le_index_aux✝.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : ℝ} (hf : f.Monic)
  (hfα : (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0) (r : σ → ℕ) (B C : ℕ) (J : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)) {γ : ℝ}
  (hC : ∀ W ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B, ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree, |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑C)
  (hcount : ↑(2 * C + 1) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < (↑B + 1) ^ ∏ k, (r k + 1))
  (hJ : ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (k : σ), d k ≤ r k) → Roth.weight r d < γ → d ∈ J) :
  ∃ P ∈ Roth.RSet (↑B) r, γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) (fun x ↦ α) r

private theorem Roth.exists_mem_RSet_le_index_aux.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ}
  {α : ℝ},
  f.Monic →
    (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0 →
      ∀ (r : σ → ℕ) (B C : ℕ) (J : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)) {γ : ℝ},
        (∀ W ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B, ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree, |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑C) →
          ↑(2 * C + 1) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < (↑B + 1) ^ ∏ k, (r k + 1) →
            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (k : σ), d k ≤ r k) → Roth.weight r d < γ → d ∈ J) →
              ∃ P ∈ Roth.RSet (↑B) r, γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) (fun x ↦ α) r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {f} {α} hf hfα r B C J {γ} hC hcount hJ ↦
  Exists.casesOn
    (Roth.exists_ne_modByMonic_eq r B hf J C hC
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congr
            (congrArg LT.lt
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg HPow.hPow
                  (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_add (2 * C) 1) (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Nat.cast_mul 2 C)) Nat.cast_one)))
                (f.natDegree * J.card)))
            (congrArg (HPow.hPow (↑B + 1)) (finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype fun i ↦ r i + 1))))
        (Eq.mp
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LT.lt
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg HPow.hPow
                  (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_add (2 * C) 1) (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Nat.cast_mul 2 C)) Nat.cast_one)))
                (f.natDegree * J.card)))
            ((↑B + 1) ^ ∏ k, (r k + 1)))
          hcount)))
    fun W' h ↦
    And.casesOn h fun hW' right ↦
      Exists.casesOn right fun W'' h ↦
        And.casesOn h fun hW'' right ↦
          And.casesOn right fun hne hWeq ↦
            have hP := Roth.sub_mem_RSet hW' hW'' hne;
            Exists.intro (W' - W'')
              ⟨hP,
                Roth.le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero
                  ((map_ne_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                        (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)).mpr
                    hP.left)
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (forall_congr fun j ↦
                        congrFun'
                          (congrArg LE.le
                            (Multiset.count.congr_simp j j (Eq.refl j) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) (W' - W'')).degrees
                              (W' - W'').degrees
                              ((fun x_0 x_1 ↦ (fun x_0 x_1 ↦ degrees_map_of_injective x_1 Int.cast_injective) x_0 x_1) σ
                                (W' - W''))))
                          (r j)))
                    hP.right.left)
                  (fun x ↦ α) fun d hd hw ↦ Roth.eval_hasseDeriv_sub_eq_zero hfα (hWeq d (hJ d hd hw))⟩

MAINLEMMA_PRIVATE259_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : ℝ},
  f.Monic →
    (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0 →
      ∀ (r : σ → ℕ) (B C : ℕ) (J : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)) {γ : ℝ},
        (∀ W ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B, ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree, |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑C) →
          ↑(2 * C + 1) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < (↑B + 1) ^ ∏ k : σ, (r k + 1) →
            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (k : σ), d k ≤ r k) → Roth.weight r d < γ → d ∈ J) →
              ∃ P ∈ Roth.RSet (↑B) r, γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) (fun (x : σ) ↦ α) r
